explanation: Tamarind trees came from tropical Africa, yet the name comes from the Arabic tamr hindi, 'Indian date', after the sticky brown pulp.

claims.text: Tamarind pulp flavours Worcestershire sauce, sambar and many chutneys.

The tamarind tree is native to tropical Africa.
The word tamarind comes from the Arabic tamr hindi, meaning Indian date.
